Seriously, what the hell is an anomaly?

115320.synopsis:
Alright, listen up.
In modern anime and manga, the so-called background girls are on a whole different level.
Sometimes they’re just as beautiful as the main heroine—sometimes even more!
And yet, despite their looks, they get zero love.
No one flirts with them, no one asks them out. It’s like the world just ignores them.
One day, I noticed that.
And that’s when it hit me.
Why isn’t anyone paying attention to Tanaka-san?
She’s—at least in my totally biased opinion—the absolute cutest girl in our entire school.
And yet, she’s not popular.
Not admired.
Not even rumored to be dating someone.
Unbelievable. 　
So I made a decision.
Forget the main heroine.
I’m going after Tanaka-san.
“But hold up… how do you even approach a girl who barely shows up in the original story?! I’ve never even had a normal romance before—how am I supposed to turn her into my girlfriend?!”
This is a story about two nobodies falling in love.
While the main characters are busy with their flashy romcom, we’re just here, doing our own thing.
Quiet. Awkward. Sweet.
And maybe—just maybe—a little bit special.
associated_names: メインヒロインより可愛いモブの田中さん

117624.synopsis:
Bai Yujing transmigrated to a supernatural city where demons and monsters roam. After ten years of secluded cultivation, he has mastered forbidden spells, become fluent in sacred scriptures, unlocked Bankai, and achieved unmatched prowess in martial arts—invincible across the human world.
Yet even someone as powerful as him has his worries. How can he possibly conquer the boundless Demon Realm that stretches like the universe itself?
“Forget it. Let’s just make Qingyun Sect the number one faction in the world first.”
His very first disciple? A scheming femme fatale…
“I’m Liu Shuangling, a diligent, goal-oriented go-getter with world domination on my to-do list. I’d just taken the first step in my life plan when I ran into this monster. Went all-out in battle but still lost, so now I’m stuck joining his sect.
But don’t get it twisted—I’m not giving up on my dream of ruling the world!
Enough talking, I’ve got a junior and third junior sister with ambitions of their own waiting to team up and take over the sect!”

118904.synopsis:
Just as Yu Miaomiao picked up her phone to check the game link message, her vision went dark, and in the blink of an eye, she found herself inside a post-apocalyptic survival game — Desert Survival.
【Player Real Name: Yu Miaomiao
Player Nickname: MeowMeowNoWaterShortage
Age: 23
Game Traits: Luck
Stamina: 30 (upgradeable)
Agility: 66 (upgradeable)
Intelligence: 15 (upgradeable)
Strength: 35 (upgradeable)
Luck: 900 (not upgradeable)】
What does this mean? Judging by the luck value, her intelligence is only 15 — isn’t that too low? She’s not that dumb, right? This was the first time Yu Miaomiao doubted her own IQ. What kind of broken system was this?
【Luck Trait Activated Successfully, Newbie Gift Pack: One worn-out outdoor sun umbrella, half a bottle of mineral water, one single-person children’s straw mat】
Who else would be so lucky as to get a broken umbrella and a kids’ straw mat? Only her. It wasn’t until Yu Miaomiao drew supplies from cards, made materials, and planted crops that were just a tiny bit more than others that everyone realized that the ‘MeowMeowNoWaterShortage’ on the leaderboard was not simple at all.

119416.synopsis:
Jiang Rong was born in a world where every family dreams of having an Alpha or Omega child. But at eighteen, he hadn’t differentiated into either—he was just an unremarkable Beta. His parents treated him with cold indifference, practically ignoring his existence.
Heaven seemed to take pity on him. Not long after starting his sophomore year, he transmigrated to a world with only two genders: male and female. Taking the place of a student with the same name, he breathed in the fresh air of gender freedom.
Until one day, his roommate noticed a scent on him.
In a world without Alphas, Jiang Rong had differentiated into an Omega…
One day, Jiang Rong went to a bar to pick up his heartbroken, drunken roommate. As his Omega heat cycle struck at the worst possible moment, he found himself caught in a dilemma. By chance, he ran into his roommate’s friend, who was drinking at the bar. Though they weren’t close, Jiang Rong sensed the faint trace of pheromones on the other man. Desperate, he dragged him to a nearby hotel.
They stayed there for three days.
The man he slept with was none other than He Siming, the famously aloof and handsome campus heartthrob.
As they parted, Jiang Rong glanced at the tr*sh bin and panicked: “Did we… skip protection a few times?”
He Siming, visibly drained, replied: “Mm.”
Jiang Rong clutched his hair, muttering anxiously, “It’s over, it’s over. I might get pregnant.”
He Siming: ???
‘You’re a guy. You can’t get pregnant.’
A month later.
He Siming received Jiang Rong’s pregnancy test report: “…”

122488.synopsis:
The Head of Imperial College, Yao Qizhao, was a man of integrity—honest, incorruptible, and spotless throughout his life.
But one day, he suddenly broke off his granddaughter’s engagement in the middle of the street and even struck a court official. From then on, his reputation was tarnished, and his health rapidly declined.
He had lived in poverty all his life, owning only a little over twenty strings of coins and a tiny house next to the Imperial College… which, as it turns out, still carried a massive mortgage owed to Xingguo Temple!
When Yao Ruyi, who had lost an eight-year battle with cancer in her previous life, transmigrated into this body, the temple was knocking to collect the debt, the rice jar in the kitchen was empty, and the original owner had planned to die together with her gravely ill grandfather.
But now, with this healthy body, no matter how hard life gets, Yao Ruyi is determined to survive.
Especially since Grandpa Yao’s house has a hidden door that connects directly to the back gate of the Imperial College — prime position in the heart of Bianjing!
Yao Ruyi pulls herself together and restarts her old family business from her previous life, opening a school shop in ancient times — selling stationery, sausages, fruit, breakfast, poetry collections, “Become a Scholar in 3 Years,” “Top of the Exam in 5 Years,” as well as basins, buckets, toothbrushes, towels, laundry powder…
While working hard to pay off the debt, she also gets to admire the handsome, talented young scholars of the Imperial College every day. Life starts to feel pretty good.
—
After years away mourning his mother and recovering from injury, Lin Wen’an finally returns to the capital, only to hear that his mentor’s family had been destroyed. Rushing back in hurry, he finds the little courtyard has been transformed into a vibrant street-side shop, shelves overflowing with goods. From behind a tall counter, a bright-eyed young girl with a charming smile peeks out:
“Sir, would you like to buy something?”
“…” This… this is the same shy, timid granddaughter of his mentor who used to be too afraid to even speak??
Lin Wen’an hesitates for a moment. Just then, from the back courtyard, he hears the booming scolding voice of his former mentor:
“You call this a solution? What a mess! It’s better to quit school and go home to farm!”
Peeking in, Lin Wen’an sees a few trembling students standing under the eaves, being berated like pickled vegetables, while the old man drinks tea from a massive mug and whacks them on the head with a ruler.
Lin Wen’an: “…” Who started that rumor?! Who?!
—
Before reading:
1. Warm, slice-of-life business management story with light ensemble cast.
2. Set in a fictionalized version of the Song Dynasty — fully fictional.
3. Super sweet romance. Older man x younger woman. Male lead is 7 years older. Fake-shy girl x quiet, stoic big wolfdog man.

125560.synopsis:
She’s a third-generation gangster heiress raised in a world where money and fists rule,
and now she has to enter a contract marriage with a guy from another mob family?!
Yang Hyejin, the third-generation daughter of a gang family, cut ties with her violent father and his equally brutish, fist-happy son—her older brother—when she entered college. It’s been nine years of peace… until her mother’s life is suddenly held hostage to force her into a blind date.
The catch? The guy is Kim Mugang, the son of another mob boss.
In short, a thug.
“Are you the type to match your partner’s pace?”
“No. I’m the type to cut off even family if they don’t.”
“Cold women are kinda sexy.”
“Men who say that to your face aren’t.”
Bound by a forced political marriage between criminal organizations,
can Hyejin and Mugang find a way to make it work—or is death the only escape from this deal?

129400.synopsis:
An operator pours their heart and soul into maintaining the balance.
But what can I do? My very existence is already game-breaking.
associated_names: Descent with a Cosmic-Tier Administrator Account

131192.synopsis:
[Exquisite and selfish female protagonist + paranoid and possessive male protagonist] 
Selfish, materialistic, and sophisticated self-interest.
Even so, there are countless people who love her.
In the original novel, Lin Luoxue is the heroine’s cannon fodder sister who despises the poor and loves the rich. She is three-timing. Even after marriage, she remains unfaithful and ultimately dies while eloping with her adulterer.
She has a bad character, is selfish, plays with feelings and laughs at sincerity, has a bad temper and is narrow-minded.
When her memories were awakened… she was still the beautiful, mischievous woman. Reformation was impossible.
【Micro】The evil girl ✘ pe*vert, they meet their match.
associated_names: 漂亮美人在年代文被偏执疯狗缠上

135544.synopsis:
By sheer accident, Jian Yue found himself bound to a deadly infinite survival game, as a live-streaming host!! 
While other top-tier streamers awakened flashy, godlike powers, Jian Yue’s ability turned out to be…. *GOSSIP*
The audience: “Pfft HAHAHA! What kind of useless ability is this? RIP, streamer!”
Rumor had it that Sadako, the vengeful spirit, killed without ever spilling blood. Betrayed by her lover and mu*dered in rage, she now hated all of mankind and was about to unleash a massacre. Everyone thought the players were doomed when suddenly.. 
Ding! Gossip Skill Activated:
【Breaking News! This S-class spirit’s lover isn’t dead at all! he ran off with another woman!】
Jian Yue: “???”
The ghost, mid-kill: “???”
The live-stream chat: “WHAT THE HELL DID WE JUST HEAR?!”
—
Next dungeon: a cursed gothic castle. The Duke and Duchess corner Jian Yue, their intentions mu*derous. Just as his fate seemed sealed
Gossip Skill:
【Hot scoop! The Duke has been cheating on his wife… with the maid!】
The Duke and Duchess lock eyes. The tension skyrockets.
The live-stream chat: “Wait wait wait……. Is this… a free soap opera? Without pay-per-view?!”
But before the drama can peak….. 
Gossip Skill again:
【Breaking update! The maid is actually a cross-dressing dude!】
Jian Yue: “…”
What kind of kinky drama are you monsters running here?!
The audience: “HAHAHAHA! This melon is too juicy! Popcorn, peanuts, sunflower seeds, we’re stocked! But wait, who does the maid actually like??”
—
As the survival game spiraled into ever more bizarre scenarios, Jian Yue’s popularity skyrocketed.
While other players fought tooth and nail, bleeding and crawling their way to survival, Jian Yue just stood there, eating melons and spilling tea. The monsters themselves supplied enough drama to keep the audience glued to the screen.
Time after time, his ridiculous Gossip Skill saved his life… until one day, in the deadliest dungeon yet, when it suddenly triggered again…. 
【Rumor has it! The terrifying Ghost King has fallen in love with… a mere human player!】
Jian Yue: “???”
The mu*derous ghost stopped mid-lunge, exchanged whispers with his comrades instead:
【The King’s in love… with that human?】
【Yeah, yeah! Word is they’ve already slept together countless times!】
Jian Yue, who only wanted snacks: “…??!!”
After the ghosts dispersed, Jian Yue turned to the man beside him, forcing a shaky laugh:
“Haha… So, uh… I overheard them saying you’re in love. That’s fake, right? You’re gonna deny it, right?”
The man’s dark eyes glimmered red. Jian Yue braced for denial….
Instead, the man leaned closer and murmured:
“…Or it could be true.”
Jian Yue: “…” Smile, gone. JPEG

142200.synopsis:
In the twelfth year of Tianhe, deep winter, on a snowy night, eleven-year-old Shaowei swung her blade to sever all blood ties and descended the mountain alone.
That night, Prince Liu Qi—who like an unlucky stray dog by the roadside had inexplicably received a beating from her—climbed up from the ground, wiped away his nosebleed, and stood in the heavy snow, watching that blood-soaked figure disappear into the distance.

150392.synopsis:
I’m a villainess. The system says I’m arrogant, domineering, and capable of any evil, destined to bring ruin upon my family and meet a tragic end. Only by binding with it can I defy fate, preserve myself, and rewrite my destiny.
I refused.
I’m five years old. My mom says I’m simple-minded, not as clever as my two older brothers or several cousins. Right now, the most important thing is getting into a good elementary school—no time for nonsense.
My mom is right.
